text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board project and spending approval for a new 10-year capital plan and budget.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved TO Live's new 10-year capital plan and budget, as detailed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 3, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Upon final approval by City Council of TO Live's 10-year capital plan and budget, approved all 2023 projects, including those with multiyear components listed in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 3, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live, and all related purchase orders and/or tender awards over $100,000 up to each individual project budget or adjusted budget, not to exceed the available State of Good Repair (SOGR) Council approved funding. 3.
